pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless unrealized profit on base tranche exceeds +$8.00 and volatility expansion confirms directional momentum.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 1.5 ATR buffer beyond recent swing extremes for stop-loss placement and a 5-tick momentum confirmation filter before execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of volume at +$10.00, trailing the remainder via parabolic SAR to capture extended $15-$30+ runs.
